about:
John A. Marshall Co. operates from Lenexa, Kansas, as a fourth-generation family-owned business. The company does not disclose its founding year or the names of its founders, but emphasizes its legacy as a family enterprise where staff are described as the backbone of its success.

The firm is a MillerKnoll Certified Dealer, selling workplace furniture from brands such as Herman Miller, Knoll, Framery, and Artome, and also operates a flooring division, FDC Contract. Its service portfolio covers the full project lifecycle: space planning and design, project management, delivery and installation, relocation and reconfiguration, asset and inventory management (including receiving, inspection, and short- and long-term storage), maintenance and warranty support for Herman Miller’s 12-year warranty, leasing and finance solutions, and furniture rental coordination. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Clients span multiple sectors. Testimonials reference projects for the Sheraton Overland Park Hotel (hospitality), the Food Bank of Eastern Oklahoma (non-profit), SFG Consulting Group (consulting), TED Renewables (renewable energy), Outdoor Bank (banking), OneDigital (financial services), and Compass Minerals (mining/minerals), indicating a focus on corporate office environments across diverse industries.

The company positions its family ownership and end-to-end service model as differentiators, stating it aims to be a reliable business partner that delivers furniture and flooring projects on time and within budget. Its MillerKnoll certification and integrated flooring division are highlighted as part of a comprehensive offering.
